brief: Four things the last five iterations built that the viewer cannot see at 1x, each with a cue and a number. (c91) every lit pane at midnight reads grey (105,100,110): `drawLitPanes()` runs at ~4029, `applyLight` at ~4232 — draw the lit panes (and their LIT[] glow) AFTER the tint so windows glow warm, and check the rose window and TAP_DOOR get the same treatment. (c88) turned earth (`turned[]`, #3d2d1c) is dark brown on brown from the wide shot — give a turned cell a furrow texture or a colder, more saturated tint. (c84) bunting flags are ~3 px at 1x so the flutter #50 built only reads on a contact sheet — larger flags, fewer if needed. (c83) the snowy lawn at dawn reads pale green: a whiter `SNOW_COL` floor under the dawn tint, or a cover floor for the mixed range. One commit, four crops vs HEAD at the same pinned instants.
successLooksLike: Pane-warmth probe (`probes/pane-warmth.mjs`) reports a lit pane at midnight with R − B ≥ 40 (HEAD −5); a seed-7 midwinter noon crop shows the turned plots as a distinct value from a fallow one by ≥ 25 luminance; flags ≥ 5 px at 1x; the seed-7 winter dawn crop's snowed lawn mean has B ≥ G. Census unchanged; noon summer frame byte-identical to HEAD (nothing here fires in summer daylight).
avoid: No behaviour change, no new R() draw, no new ground kind. If the pane reorder pulls a reflection or glow out of the night pass, fix the order, not the colour constant.
